verdict.rationale: Org-wide admin policy enforcement is a fair question for a 2FA authenticator app, but the evidence shows no admin console or centrally enforced policies. Privacy Screen is a per-user optional toggle ("you can turn on Privacy Screen"), an adjacent feature rather than an admin-mandated app lock. Nothing in the pack covers restricting export or mandating master credentials across members.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can enforce org-wide policies — require app lock, restrict export, mandate strong master credentials — across every member's app
